## Summary

Split from plan 206 (06 Nov). Sources: #122's review (F003), the wave B dogfood (F13, F15, F16), pm-001's holder assigns (F17), and the prime (F18). Under the prime's ruling, the F003 test is deleted in a one-line PR on its first CI failure; if that happens before this plan, AC for F003 restores a deterministic version.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- The s04 follow-ups split from plan 206 on the prime's instruction: record closed seats in lineage (F15), batch assign (F16), zoned dates (F13), the two-role window name (F17), the writer's index.lock marker and retry (F18), and the #122 same-second test (F003).

## Acceptance criteria

| id | claim | state | note | receipt | pressure | proven_by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ac-0001 | F15, lineage import. `pij directory lineage add &lt;role&gt;[/&lt;instance&gt;] &lt;seat&gt; --from &lt;time&gt; --to &lt;time&gt; --why &lt;text&gt;` lets the prime record a closed seat's past holding (no live seat needed), validated against overlaps; refused for anyone but the prime. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | F16, batch assign. `pij directory assign --batch &lt;file&gt;` (role, instance, seat lines) records many holders in one writer commit, all or nothing. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | F003, the latent flake. The same-second HTTP test from #122 stops assuming a wall-clock second (inject the clock or drop the precondition) and keeps proving that rapid assign, release and reassign never collide. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0003](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0004 | F13, zones. Changelog and holder dates written by the writer carry an explicit zone (RFC 3339 with offset or Z), and the view prints the local time with its zone. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0004](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0005 | F18 (low, from the prime): a hand commit in the standing governance worktree can fail on index.lock while the daemon's writer is committing there (seen 06 Nov: the prime's commit raced the close writer's 655c0b6). While it holds the index, the writer leaves a short-lived marker naming itself (for example .git/pij-writer.owner with seat, pid and time, removed on exit); the community README tells humans to retry after a moment when they see it; and the writer's own commits retry briefly on a foreign index.lock (bounded), then refuse by name. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0005](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0006 | F17 (low): a seat holding two roles gets the last assign's window name. The window is named for the seat's primary holding (the earliest open one), or `&lt;project&gt;:&lt;role1&gt;+&lt;role2&gt;`; pick one, and say so in the docs. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0006](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0007 | F24 (low, pm-001, 06 Nov): `just shared-build`'s owner file records `seat=&lt;user&gt;` because PIJ_ID is unset in harness seats, so a lock holder can't be told apart (seen: seat=jordanknight for warbler's run). The recipe takes the seat id from the pij registration of its caller (`pij whoami` or the daemon's view of the calling pid) when PIJ_ID is unset, and falls back to the user only outside a seat. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0007](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0008 | Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). Batch assign is one writer commit for many holders; lineage add is one commit; the writer's lock retry is bounded and only on a foreign lock. No timer or poll. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0008](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0009 | Docs and states. No roadmap state change (follow-up work). docs/difficulties.md: F13, F15, F16, F17, F18 and #122 F003 marked resolved. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0009](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
